* This site is 'related' to all sites on the same planet that the [[Sandcrawler]] is on.
* This site does ''not'' take on the name of the planet (e.g. it is not a [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] site, a character here is not 'on [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]]' or 'on Cloud City' even if the [[Sandcrawler]] is, etc).
